title: EOP-UAP-D001, NASC Inquiry into Bahia, Brazil Incident, November 13, 1963
doc_notes: This document is a CIA FBIS wire report regarding a reported crash in Brazil, annotated by NASC officials requesting diplomatic verification.

incidents.summary: A large metal sphere reportedly crashed in the center of Conde, Bahia, creating a four-meter deep hole and containing a deceased occupant in heavy clothing.
incidents.quote: A LARGE METAL SPHERE FELL IN THE CENTER OF THE CITY, GOUGING A HOLE FOUR METERS DEEP.
